# Penn World Table 10.01 (Feenstra, Inklaar and Timmer), as shipped in the CRAN package pwt10 10.01-0

External reference, no bytes stored. Publisher: Groningen Growth and Development Centre, University of Groningen; R packaging by Achim Zeileis (CRAN, mirrored at github.com/cran/pwt10). Source: https://www.rug.nl/ggdc/productivity/pwt/pwt-releases/pwt1001.

PWT 10.01 (January 2023) covers 183 countries, 1950-2019; the release is also on DataverseNL, doi:10.34894/QT5BCC. The consumer reads the R data file data/pwt10.01.rda of package pwt10 10.01-0 from the read-only GitHub mirror of CRAN at one fixed commit, so that a Git commit fixes the bytes, and checks its SHA-256. PWT 11.0 (October 2025, through 2023) supersedes it but has no pinned mirror yet. Variables used: cgdpo, emp, cn, hc (output-side GDP and capital stock at current PPPs, persons engaged, human capital index). Cite Feenstra, Inklaar and Timmer (2015), "The Next Generation of the Penn World Table", American Economic Review 105(10), 3150-3182. No bytes are mirrored here.
